related_questions.question: Who is eligible for partner visa in UK?

text_blocks.snippet: To obtain a UK partner visa, applicants generally need to be over 18 and in a genuine and subsisting relationship with a British citizen or settled person (someone with Indefinite Leave to Remain, Settled Status, or proof of permanent residence). A key requirement is demonstrating that the relationship is genuine and will be maintained, along with proving the sponsor meets the financial requirements (minimum income of £29,000 per year or equivalent savings). Additional requirements include proving cohabitation (if applicable), meeting English language proficiency, and having suitable accommodation.
snippet_highlighted_words: applicants generally need to be over 18 and in a genuine and subsisting relationship with a British citizen or settled person

list.snippet: Age: Both the applicant and the sponsor must be at least 18 years old.

Marriage or Civil Partnership: The relationship must be a valid marriage or civil partnership recognized in the UK, or evidence of cohabitation for at least two years in a relationship similar to marriage.
Genuine and Subsisting Relationship: The relationship must be real and ongoing, with evidence to support its genuineness.
Intention to Live Together: The couple must intend to live together permanently in the UK.
Previous Relationships: Any prior marriages or civil partnerships must have ended permanently.
Cohabitation (if applicable): Proof of cohabitation for at least two years is needed if not married or in a civil partnership.

list.title: Minimum Income:
list.snippet: The sponsor needs to demonstrate an income of at least £29,000 per year, or have sufficient savings to meet the financial requirement.

list.title: Sources of Income:
list.snippet: Acceptable sources of income may include employment, self-employment, pensions, and certain benefits.

list.title: Savings:
list.snippet: If relying on savings, the amount must be sufficient to cover the income threshold over a period of time.

list.title: Public Funds:
list.snippet: The couple must not rely on public funds (benefits).

list.title: English Language Requirement:
list.snippet: The applicant must demonstrate English language proficiency, usually through an approved English language test.

list.title: Accommodation:
list.snippet: The couple must have suitable accommodation in the UK for themselves and any dependants.

list.title: Valid Passport and Visa:
list.snippet: The applicant needs a valid passport and, if required, a visa to enter the UK.

list.title: Sponsor's Eligibility:
list.snippet: The sponsor must be a British citizen, have settled status (ILR or Settled Status), or have pre-settled status if they are from the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and living in the UK since before January 1, 2021.

list.title: Prohibited Degrees of Relationship:
list.snippet: The couple must not be within a prohibited degree of relationship (e.g., close family members).

list.title: Meeting in Person:
list.snippet: The couple must have met in person.

related_questions.question: Can I move to the UK if I buy a business?
related_questions.snippet: If you are not a British citizen, you will need a visa to immigrate to the UK after you buy a business. UK visa requirements are reasonably strict, and there are many different types available. Until March 2019, foreign nationals who planned to buy or invest in a UK business could apply for a Tier 1 Entrepreneur visa.
